supersession_history.note: Those runs' NFS wing.vertex was already correct (matched the canonical file) -- only the hinge value baked into their decks was stale.
supersession_history.reason: Fixed a wing-hinge geometry defect (fix-force-surrogate-sweep-hinge); these decks replace the ones used by these cluster runs, whose raw CFD output on NFS predated this fix and was stale.

supersession_history.note: 15 of 27 runs from pzdhl/zpkvt were CFL-limited (ns.cfl=0.3 bound below ns.fixed_dt=0.0005 at this grid resolution), truncating them mid-wingbeat; the other 12 completed but at an unvalidated timestep policy. PR #91 (add-fine-corpus-cluster-run) is being superseded by a full 27-config re-run at the corrected policy.
supersession_history.reason: Raised ns.cfl 0.3 -> 0.6 (issue #92, add-fine-corpus-run-verification) so the validated fixed timestep binds instead of being CFL-limited; these decks replace the ones used by pzdhl/zpkvt, whose raw CFD output on NFS predates this fix.

timestep_policy.rationale: ns.cfl raised to 0.6 so the validated fixed timestep (0.0005) binds instead of being CFL-limited at this grid resolution -- ns.fixed_dt is a ceiling, not an enforced value; ns.cfl is an independent limiter that can reduce the realized timestep below it (issue #92).
